The combination of ondansetron with medications that prolong the QT interval, cause electrolyte abnormalities, congestive heart failure (CHF), or bradyarrhythmias may increase the risk of adverse cardiac events. ECG monitoring is recommended in such cases. 2. Co-administration of fluoxetine and ondansetron can increase the QTc interval. Both drugs also elevate serotonin levels, potentially increasing toxicity. Avoid this combination or use alternative drugs. 3. Fluphenazine and ondansetron both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid their combination or consider alternative therapies. 4. In patients with congenital long QT syndrome, avoid ondansetron or any concomitant medications that prolong the QT interval. ECG monitoring is advised when using such combinations, especially in the presence of electrolyte abnormalities, CHF, or bradyarrhythmias. 5.
